dropped.PolicyNumber: Unique ID — non-predictive and would leak identity.
dropped.RepNumber: Adjuster ID — high cardinality process artifact, not claim content.
dropped.AgeOfPolicyHolder: Binned duplicate of Age; kept numeric Age instead.

kept.Age: Numeric driver age; zeros treated as missing.
kept.Year: Claim year kept as ordered categorical context (not an ID).

why_not_accuracy: Fraud is ~6% of claims. A model that always predicts non-fraud is ~94% accurate while catching zero fraud. Precision, recall, and PR-AUC measure the rare-class trade-off that accuracy hides.
